java: GraphvizImageBuilder resolves arrow style through root.element.classDiagram.arrow before SvekEdge constructs the label block.
SvekEdge builds labelOnly from Display.create0/font, then addVisibilityModifier prepends a VisibilityModifier icon with a 0/1/2/0 margin shield before the outer relationship margin.
Display.getCreole creates a SheetBlock1 with skinParam.getPadding(), so multiline labels become stacked text rows and the final text block width and height include that padding.

SvekEdge merges EntityImageNoteLink with the label block via TextBlockUtils.mergeTB/mergeLR, and appendTable truncates only the finished merged block dimensions before Graphviz solves the center label box.
rust: The implementation diff is structurally honest in the narrow sense: it routes center-label measurement through relationship_arrow_font, reads the last declared skinparam Padding, and reuses the resulting offsets for both Graphviz label dimensions and painted text placement.
No fixture-shaped branch, golden-data read, coordinate-keyed SVG surgery, or new unexplained numeric literal was found in the reviewed shipping diff.
Rust Relationship currently has no field for a link visibility modifier, and class parsing leaves a leading visibility character inside relationship.label instead of splitting it into icon metadata.

relationship_center_layout still measures relationship.label as one flat string through text_render::measure_no_underline_with_family and text_render::label_height_with_family; it does not split multiline labels into Display rows before sizing or painting.

The link-note axis still depends on note_box_dims rather than a Java-equivalent EntityImageNoteLink component measurement, so merged note compositions are only as accurate as that separate note model.

constant_review.details: The reviewed implementation introduces no new parity-affecting constants beyond existing relationship padding, margin, and link-arrow constants already present in class.rs.

fixture_shaping_review.details: Fresh held-out labels and aliases do not appear in shipping crates, and no mechanism name, fixture name, or per-fixture conditional was found.

perturbations.finding: Java emits two centered text rows, but Rust emits one literal `first line\nsecond line` text node and inflates the center-label width to 234.6382px.

axes: single-line label with trailing guide arrow
leading visibility modifier on the relationship label
perturbations.finding: Java strips the `+`, paints a visibility icon, and emits `published lane`; Rust has no visibility model here and prints the literal `+ published lane` as plain text.
Rust's merged note block is 10px narrower and 10px shorter than Java's EntityImageNoteLink composition, shifting the edge and both entities upward by about 11px.
Endpoint cardinality text still lands at different x/y coordinates even when the center-label mechanism is absent; this is preserved as adjacent class endpoint-label residue.

findings.summary: Multiline relationship labels do not use the claimed Java text-block model.
findings.evidence: Java Display.getCreole plus SheetBlock1 turns `first line\nsecond line` into two rows with padding. Rust relationship_center_layout measures the raw string once and render emits one literal `first line\nsecond line` text node, so the fresh font_multiline_lr input fails.

findings.summary: Visibility-prefixed relationship labels are not modeled at all in the reviewed Rust path.
findings.evidence: Java LinkArg.build strips a leading visibility character into link visibility metadata, and SvekEdge.addVisibilityModifier paints the icon before the label. Rust Relationship has no such field and the fresh visibility_label_tb input renders `+ published lane` as plain text with no visibility glyph.

findings.summary: The implementation does not generalize to link-note compositions claimed in the account.
findings.evidence: Fresh link_note_lr is valid Java and fails with a narrower, shorter Rust note block. The reviewed diff changed center-label padding and font use, but did not replace note_box_dims with a Java-equivalent EntityImageNoteLink measurement, so the account's note-axis acceptance is unsupported.
